findings.detail: The 7.50 basis spread is source-supported as SOFR + 7.50%, so the row should not be treated as a fixed-rate instrument.

rationale: X04 is a within-row rate classification conflict. The raw source row presents the instrument as a Term Loan with Reference Rate and Spread of SOFR + 7.50% and an interest rate of 11.63%, so the stored basis_spread value 7.5 is not the wrong field. The data error is the row being treated as fixed-rate for validation despite floating-rate source terms. Other 7.50% hits in the schedule also appear as SOFR + 7.50%, which lowers row-specific certainty but supports the same localization.
